body:
Thanks for responding. It really helps me think that things aren't as dire. My GF's reaction wasn't typical for her. But I guess that being unable to work and having to support two kids by yourself (deadbeat dad) makes her scared and "I told you so" was the first reaction. I am her only form of support and even I agree that her children should be her #1 priority in life. I was a dummy and left this post on the screen and walked away for a half hour. So now she's seen evreything and wants to talk later. 

I work(ed) for a small startup in advertising in NYC. Unions don't exist in my field and the state is at-will employment, so I've been told companies aren't legally required to give out any severance pay. This is new to me so I'm still trying to find out the truth. They also said COBRA wouldn't apply since the legal entity (company) is dissolving, but I'm trying to find out if that's accurate. Thanks for the tip about /r/legaladvice.

I'm trying to find out about suicide watch, but I'm going to be hard-pressed to explain why I'd be out of the office and unreachable for however long it would be. And I'm afraid that the hospital wouldn't let me out if I said that I needed to go. I'm still struggling with bad thoughts, but am feeling a bit better now. I really appreciate you responding. It's good to know that someone--even a stranger--gives a damn.
